title: "KPC_tumours_scRNAseq_processing"
author: "Alex Brown"
date: "2025-11-13"
output: html_document
---



# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in the data

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_data <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/GSE126388_scRNAseq_KPC_tumours/GSE126388_KPC_med.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)

KPC_large_tumour_data <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/GSE126388_scRNAseq_KPC_tumours/GSE126388_KPC_large.txt", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
```



# Collapse duplicate genes and set genes as rownames

```{r, include=FALSE}
gene_names_KPC_med <- KPC_med_tumour_data[, 1]
counts_KPC_med <- as.matrix(KPC_med_tumour_data[, -1])

gene_names_KPC_large <- KPC_large_tumour_data[, 1]
counts_KPC_large <- as.matrix(KPC_large_tumour_data[, -1])

# Sum rows with the same gene name
counts_KPC_med <- rowsum(counts_KPC_med, group = gene_names_KPC_med)

counts_KPC_large <- rowsum(counts_KPC_large, group = gene_names_KPC_large)
```



# Create Seurat Object

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_KPC_med, min.cells = 3, project = "Medium KPC tumour")

KPC_large_tumour_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_KPC_large, min.cells = 3, project = "Large KPC tumour")
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPC_med_tumour_so, pattern = "^mt-")

KPC_large_tumour_so[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KPC_large_tumour_so, pattern = "^mt-")
```



# 2. Filtering

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_so_filtered <- subset(KPC_med_tumour_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)

KPC_large_tumour_so_filtered <- subset(KPC_large_tumour_so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
```



# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_KPC_med_tumour <- rownames(KPC_med_tumour_so_filtered)

all_genes_KPC_large_tumour <- rownames(KPC_large_tumour_so_filtered)
```


## Medium

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_so_norm <- KPC_med_tumour_so_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPC_med_tumour) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPC_med_tumour_so_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_so_norm <- KPC_med_tumour_so_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:43) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:43)
```


## Large

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_large_tumour_so_norm <- KPC_large_tumour_so_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KPC_large_tumour) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPC_large_tumour_so_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_large_tumour_so_norm <- KPC_large_tumour_so_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:35) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:35)
```



# 4. scDblFinder

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPC_med_tumour_so_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPC_med_tumour_so_norm))

KPC_large_tumour_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KPC_large_tumour_so_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KPC_large_tumour_so_norm))


KPC_med_tumour_so_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPC_med_tumour_dbl$scDblFinder.class

KPC_large_tumour_so_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KPC_large_tumour_dbl$scDblFinder.class
```


## See numbers of singlets vs. doublets

```{r}
table(KPC_med_tumour_so_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(KPC_large_tumour_so_norm$scDblFinder.class)
```


## Remove Doublets

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_med_tumour_singlets <- subset(KPC_med_tumour_so_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

KPC_large_tumour_singlets <- subset(KPC_large_tumour_so_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
```



# 5. Combine conditions

## Merge data

```{r, include=FALSE}
ordered_datasets <- c(KPC_med_tumour_singlets, KPC_large_tumour_singlets)

features_merge <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ordered_datasets)
```


## Find anchors

```{r, include=FALSE}
anchors_merge <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = list(KPC_med_tumour_singlets, KPC_large_tumour_singlets), anchor.features = features_merge)
```


## Combine data

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_combined <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors_merge)

DefaultAssay(KPC_combined) <- "integrated"
```



# 6. Reprocess

## Scale data and run PCA
```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_KPC_tumours <- rownames(KPC_combined)
KPC_combined <- ScaleData(KPC_combined, features = all_genes_KPC_tumours)
KPC_combined <- RunPCA(KPC_combined, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KPC_combined, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```


## Cluster

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_combined <- KPC_combined %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)

Idents(KPC_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

umap.method = 'umap-learn'
metric = 'correlation'

KPC_combined <- RunUMAP(KPC_combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:41)
```



# 7. Annotate cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPC_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster_ids <- levels(KPC_combined$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(KPC_combined) <- "RNA"

Idents(KPC_combined) <- KPC_combined$seurat_clusters
KPC_combined <- JoinLayers(KPC_combined, what = "all")

DEGs_KPC_combined <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = KPC_combined, group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
  test.use = "LR", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_labels <- c("Tumour cells", 
                 "Tumour cells", 
                 "Monocytes/macrophages",
                 "Tumour cells",
                 "Tumour cells",
                 "Tumour cells",
                 "Enterocytes",
                 "CAFs",
                 "Tumour cells",
                 "Endothelial cells")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster_to_cell_type <- setNames(cluster_labels, cluster_ids)

KPC_combined$seurat_clusters <- cluster_labels[KPC_combined$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(KPC_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Tumour cells", "Endothelial cells", "CAFs", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Enterocytes"))
```

### DotPlot to show differentially expressed genes between clusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(KPC_combined) <- "RNA"
Idents(KPC_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = KPC_combined, features = c(
  "Igfbp4", "Kras", "Cldn18", "Ccnd1", "Msln", "Prom1", # Tumour cells
  "Sox9", "Hnf1b", "Cftr", "Krt19", # Pancreas-specific cells
  "Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Igfbp3", "Igfbp7", # Endothelial cells
  "Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Serping1", "Dcn", "Fn1", "Mmp13", "Timp1", # Cancer-associated fibroblasts
  "Ptprc", # General immune cells
  "Cpa3", "Tpsb2", # Mast cells
  "Fscn1", "Flt3", # Dendritic cells
  "Cd209a", "Itgam", "Ccr2", "Fabp5", "Ly6c1", "Ly6c2", # Monocytes
  "Cd68", "Cd74", "Cd83", "Ccl6", "Ccl9", "C1qa", # Macrophages
  "S100a8", "S100a9", "Retnlg", "Ifitm1", # Neutrophils
  "Cd79a", # B cells
  "Il7r", "Cd4", # T cells
  "Nkg7", "Klra7", # NK cells
  "Gypa", "Hba-a2", # Erythrocytes
  "Epcam", "Krt15" # Epithelial cells
  )) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Remove Enterocytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
enterocytes_removed <- "Enterocytes"

KPC_combined <- subset(KPC_combined, seurat_clusters != enterocytes_removed)
```


## Split Monocytes and macrophages

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPC_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages <- subset(KPC_combined, idents = "Monocytes/macrophages")

Monocytes_macrophages <- NormalizeData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindVariableFeatures(Monocytes_macrophages, nfeatures = 2000)
Monocytes_macrophages <- ScaleData(Monocytes_macrophages)
Monocytes_macrophages <- RunPCA(Monocytes_macrophages, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(Monocytes_macrophages, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Monocytes_macrophages <- FindNeighbors(Monocytes_macrophages,reduction = "pca", dims = 1:48) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

Monocytes_macrophages <- RunUMAP(Monocytes_macrophages, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:48)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "RNA"

Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters
Monocytes_macrophages <- JoinLayers(Monocytes_macrophages, what = "all")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(Monocytes_macrophages) <- "seurat_clusters"

Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels <- c("Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Tumour cells", "Macrophages", "Monocytes")

Monocytes_macrophages_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages@meta.data$seurat_clusters

Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters <- Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels[Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into KPC_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_combined$seurat_clusters <- as.character(KPC_combined$seurat_clusters)

KPC_combined$seurat_clusters[Cells(Monocytes_macrophages)] <- 
  as.character(Monocytes_macrophages$seurat_clusters)

KPC_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(KPC_combined$seurat_clusters)

rm(Monocytes_macrophages, DEGs_Monocytes_macrophages, Monocytes_macrophages_cluster_labels, Monocytes_macrophages_clusters)
```


## Order clusters again

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(KPC_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Tumour cells", "Endothelial cells", "CAFs", "Monocytes", "Macrophages"))
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(anchors_merge, counts_KPC_large, counts_KPC_med, KPC_large_tumour_data, KPC_large_tumour_dbl, KPC_large_tumour_singlets, KPC_large_tumour_so, KPC_large_tumour_so_filtered, KPC_large_tumour_so_norm, KPC_med_tumour_data, KPC_med_tumour_dbl, KPC_med_tumour_singlets, KPC_med_tumour_so, KPC_med_tumour_so_filtered, KPC_med_tumour_so_norm, ordered_datasets, all_genes_KPC_large_tumour, all_genes_KPC_med_tumour, cluster_ids, cluster_labels, cluster_to_cell_type, enterocytes_removed, features_merge, gene_names_KPC_large, gene_names_KPC_med, metric, umap.method)
```


## Visualize

```{r}
KPC_cluster_colours <- c(
    "Tumour cells"         = "#C0C0C0",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "CAFs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF"
)

DimPlot(KPC_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, cols = KPC_cluster_colours) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```
